event_name: Date 01 August 2021 Time 18:56 2021 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 29 July - 1 August 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Did not follow the Race Director's Instruction.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: Reprimand (Non-driving) (This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season)
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 18 (Lance Stroll) and team representative. The driver explained that he forgot to take off the WRAO t-shirt in time during the national anthem because of the onset of rain.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 18 Pre Race Procedure
